proof_scope: JSON-first create-report contract: pydantic JSON Schema emission, sample report validation, validated Markdown/HTML rendering, and triage-error routing for invalid report payloads through the real ./run.sh entrypoint.

claims.proves: create-report exposes a pydantic-backed create_report.report.v1 schema, validates report JSON before rendering, renders Markdown/HTML views from validated JSON, routes invalid JSON through triage-error, and still satisfies the best-practices-skills contract.
claims.does_not_prove: that any project-specific report contains true live evidence, that reviewer/runtime artifacts are available, or that a generated report supports a real project decision. The included sample is a fixture.

capability_claims.description: create-report keeps a valid SKILL.md contract.
create-report emits a pydantic JSON Schema for create_report.report.v1.
create-report validates JSON before rendering Markdown or HTML views.
invalid create-report JSON fails closed and routes through triage-error instead of prose-only errors.

cases.name: rendered-markdown-comes-from-validated-json
command:
set -euo pipefail; tmp=$(mktemp -d); cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills; skills/create-report/run.sh sample --output "$tmp/report.json"; python3 - "$tmp/report.json" <<'PY'

p=sys.argv[1]; d=json.load(open(p)); d['report_id']='runtime-render-eval'; d['title']='Runtime Render Eval'; d['source_of_truth_inventory'][0]['path']='skills/create-report/scripts/report_contract.py'; d['source_of_truth_inventory'][0]['limitation']='does not prove live project truth'; json.dump(d, open(p,'w'))

cases.name: invalid-json-routes-through-triage-error
command:
set -euo pipefail; tmp=$(mktemp -d); cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills; printf '{"schema":"create_report.report.v1","report_id":"bad"}' > "$tmp/bad.json"; if skills/create-report/run.sh validate "$tmp/bad.json" > "$tmp/stdout.txt" 2> "$tmp/stderr.txt"; then exit 1; fi; python3 - "$tmp/stderr.txt" <<'PY'
import json, sys
raw=open(sys.argv[1]).read(); data=json.loads(raw[raw.find('{'):]); code=data.get('triage',{}).get('code'); ok=data.get('schema')=='create_report.validation_failure.v1' and bool(code); print('TRIAGE_ERROR_OK=%s CODE=%s' % (ok, code)); raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
